newsitem.title: CHINA: Swire's new shopping mall 55 pct leased.
newsitem.headline: Swire's new shopping mall 55 pct leased.

text.p: Swire Properties Ltd, a unit of Swire Pacific Ltd, said on Tuesday more than half of the shopping space in its equally-owned joint venture retail development with CITIC Pacific Ltd in Kowloon has been leased out.
The leasing progress in the one-million square foot shopping centre, Festival Walk, was excellent, Jolyon Culbertson, general manager of Swire Properties said in a lease signing ceremony.
"We're now over 55 percent committed and we have another 20 percent which is at its last stage of commitment," he said.
Construction of Festival Walk at Yau Yat Tsuen, the heart of the Kowloon Peninsula, would be completed in mid-1998, he added.
"It's a one million square foot shopping centre with 250 retail outlets, 30 restaurants, an 11 screen cinema and 850 car parking spaces," Culbertson said.
The shopping mall was expected to open in the Summer of 1998, he said.
Swire Properties signed lease contracts on Tuesday with Hutchison Whampoa Ltd, Esprit Holdings Ltd, AMC Entertainment Inc and Marks & Spencer Plc for a total of more than 192,500 square foot.
The leases were between five to ten years long, Culbertson said.
Monthly rentals for the shopping space in Festival Walk were between HK$50 and HK$220 per square ft, he said.
This compared to the HK$70 and HK$300 per square ft range at Swire's Pacific Place shopping acre located at the prime area of Central District on Hong Kong Island.
